title: What You Can and Can't Do - Mit tudsz, mit lehet, mit szabad
grammar: review tud/lehet/szabad and -hat/-het for ability, possibility and permission

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what I'm able to do, and explain why I can't, using tud + infinitive.
I can distinguish between tud, lehet and szabad, and use nem szabad for a strong prohibition.
